test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 08 Oct, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Seven people S, E, C, T, I, O and N are sitting around a circular table, facing the centre (but not necessarily in the same order). E is sitting second to the left of N, while N is sitting second to the left of S. Only one person is sitting between S and O when counted from the right of S. C is sitting to the immediate right of E, whereas T is sitting to the immediate left of O. Who is sitting to the immediate right of I?
solution:
Given: Seven people S, E, C, T, I, O and N are sitting around a circular table, facing the centre.

1) E is sitting second to the left of N, while N is sitting second to the left of S.

2) Only one person is sitting between S and O when counted from the right of S.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d7cfa8c3c13d6183dac5df73e5a6978b456ecd060809dcbca0faf0d200b4ef68.png] 

3) C is sitting to the immediate right of E, whereas T is sitting to the immediate left of O. 

After positioning C and T only one position is left which will be occupied by the only person left i.e. I.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bfa3db29206cffc09d71407abd5b3a9aade243f1c4cad5da952299ff45508df6.png] 

Thus, according to the final arrangement, S is sitting to the immediate right of I.

Hence, "Option 4" is the correct answer.
